results.tests: asking for the one missing fact instead of guessing it
results.ask: What's my duty cycle at 150 amps?
results.text:
150A is above what any process can do on 120V input, so you're on 240V — but I need to know which process (MIG, TIG, or Stick) since each has its own duty cycle table.

Which one are you running?None of the three processes publish a duty cycle at exactly 150A on 240V — the manual only rates specific points, and duty cycle doesn't scale linearly with current, so it can't be interpolated [p.7]:

- **MIG (240V):** rated at 100% @ 115A and 25% @ 200A [p.7]
- **TIG (240V):** rated at 100% @ 105A and 30% @ 175A [p.7]
- **Stick (240V):** rated at 100% @ 100A and 25% @ 175A [p.7]

150A falls in the gap between the two rated points for all three, so the manual gives no number there. To stay safe, work to the lower "100% continuous" figure for whichever process you're using.Tell me which process you're actually running and I can confirm the nearest rated point for it.
